q: Can you have low AMH and good egg quality?

q: What does low AMH mean at age 30?

q: Is low AMH at 35 a concern?
a: It means time matters more. Seek specialist evaluation sooner and discuss timelines for natural trying or treatment, as egg quality also begins to decline with age.

q: Should I freeze my eggs if I have low AMH at 30?
a: If you are not planning pregnancy soon, egg freezing may be worth discussing. Earlier freezing generally gives better outcomes.
